comment: A design file of another format dropped on a face while a component that is not the root is active (mitcad#1894), run where cli.import_into_design_cube saved cube.mitcad (a 20 mm cube from the origin, Body1, centre 10, 10, 10). The view's drop point is the design's, (100, 50, 20) on a face whose normal is +Z; the app converts it into the active component's coordinates (activePlacement, dropPlacement in app/files/MainWindowFiles.cpp) because insert_component places the new component in the active one.
Holder, active, placed turned a quarter about Z and moved 100 mm along X: the drop point in its coordinates is (50, 0, 20), the normal still +Z (no rotation).
The cube's corner at the drop point in the design: its centre at (100, 50, 20) + the quarter turn of (10, 10, 10) = (90, 60, 30).
Placed by the design's point as given, without the conversion, it would land elsewhere: its corner (100, 50, 20) in Holder is (50, 100, 20) in the design, its centre (40, 110, 30).
